format: Each pool's single entry flattened into ordered candidates; the first candidate whose conditions all pass is taken; count is set_count's inclusive range; bonus and explosion_decay are kept for later (neutral without enchantments or explosions).
extensions: Tables: `modifiers` (the table's modifier list) only when the jar table has one; a table without pools has `pools: []`. Pools: `conditions` (the pool's condition) and `modifiers` only when present. Candidates: the ore form (item, conditions, count, bonus, explosion_decay) when the entry's modifiers are, in order, at most one each of set_count (no add, no condition), apply_bonus and explosion_decay (no condition); otherwise (item, conditions, modifiers) with modifiers an ordered list of set_count {count [min, max], add}, apply_bonus {enchantment, formula, bonus_multiplier}, limit_count {min, max}, explosion_decay, copy_components {source, include}, copy_state {block, properties}, each with a last key `conditions` when it has a condition. A conditions list holds predicate names (strings) or objects: survives_explosion, match_block {block, state}, any_of/all_of {terms}, inverted {term}, table_bonus {enchantment, chances}, random_chance {chance}, match_tool {tag or null, items resolved}, entity_properties {entity}, location_check {offset [x, y, z], block, state}. Predicates are listed in order of first use.
